description: Hyderabad is globally renowned for its exquisite studded gold jewellery, often featuring precious stones like pearls, emeralds, and rubies. The intricate craftsmanship reflects the rich Nizam heritage of the region.

Medchal-Malkajgiri has emerged as a major hub for pharmaceutical and biotechnology manufacturing in Telangana. The district houses numerous specialized facilities producing life-saving medicines and advanced biotech solutions.

Ranga Reddy district, which encompasses the IT hub of Cyberabad, is a prominent center for the production of biscuits and confectionery items. The local food processing ecosystem supports extensive manufacturing and distribution of baked goods.
